annotations.title: Get an SEC filing document's text

description: The text of one SEC filing document, fetched from the EDGAR archive by accession number (get it from get_filings). Omit file for the primary document (the 10-K, 8-K, Form 4...), or pass an exhibit filename. HTML is converted to plain text and returned in pages of max_chars; call again with offset = next_offset for the rest. Text documents only (HTML, XML, TXT).

cik.description: Company CIK. Needed when an agent or insider submitted the filing (Form 4, Form 144, many 8-Ks); get_filings returns it.

file.description: Document filename within the filing; omit for the primary document.
